display.title: The Agunah Is Saved, Part 1
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi races to fulfill the Rebbe's request, the Rebbe asks every child to make a Mikdash Me'at, and the Alter Rebbe sends an agunah hundreds of miles to Vilna.
display.summary_long: After the song, the storyteller teaches that nothing can stand in the way of a strong will. He tells how, as a yeshiva student in 770 in the days of the Frierdiker Rebbe, Uncle Yossi was asked by the Rebbe to have cards printed for a Mishnayos-learning campaign at his father's Borough Park print shop right away. Though the presses were already cleaned and closed for the night, Uncle Yossi begged his father until he printed them, and the next day the Rebbe told him, 'You see? Nothing stands in the way of your will.' The storyteller then explains the Rebbe's request that every child make a bedroom into a Mikdash Me'at with a personal Chumash, Siddur and pushka, used every day. The main story begins: a Chassid brings his daughter, whose husband vanished three years ago, to the Alter Rebbe, who tells her to travel to Vilna and not give up until Reb Meir Refoels, a fierce opponent of the Chassidim, finds her husband. She waits stubbornly in Vilna, and Reb Meir is called to the police station about Jewish prisoners. To be continued.
display.lesson: With a strong will and Hashem's help nothing stands in the way; do what the Rebbe asks right away, and make your room a Mikdash Me'at with your own Chumash, Siddur and pushka.

advisories.note: A young woman has been an agunah for three years after her husband disappeared.
